title: Electrical, plumbing & heating
_note: English for work (english-for-work run, 2026-11-02): written by hand in British English, not yet checked by a second reader. translations.en = short definition in simple English; deHint = German translation (the 'German' tab). Words that already exist in the English lexicon are refs with a job-specific example.
intro: The words for work as an electrician, plumber or heating engineer: parts, tools, repairs, safety and talking to customers. Every word has an example sentence from a real working day in the UK.
introEasy: Do you work with electricity, water pipes or heating? Learn the words for parts, tools and safety here.
tipps: Before you touch anything, ask clearly: “Is the power off?” or “Is the water off?” Always wait for a clear answer.
Customers like short, simple explanations. Say what is wrong, what you will do and how long it will take.
If you do not understand an instruction on site, ask again: “Sorry, can you say that again?” It is much safer than guessing.
